zh: ［補充］先看左邊：黃框是 6×6 影像上的一個 3×3 視窗（感受野），再看同一條三格筆畫向右平移兩欄；右邊是共享核 K（中間欄為 1）與視窗分數 1 + 1 + 1 = 3。我們要的是類別不變，不是每個數字都不變。〔功能：1、2〕
6×6 影像上的一個視窗、3×3 共享核、分數 3，以及筆畫向右平移兩欄。
en: [Supplement] First see the left: the yellow frame is a 3×3 window (receptive field) on a 6×6 image, and the same three-cell stroke is shifted two columns right; the right shows the shared kernel K (ones in the middle column) and the window score 1 + 1 + 1 = 3. We want the class to stay, not every number. [Function: 1, 2]
A window on a 6×6 image, the 3×3 shared kernel, score 3, and the stroke shifted two columns right.

zh: ［補充］先看左邊兩張 4×4 特徵圖：F(x) 的亮處在第 0 欄（2、3、2、1）、F(Tx) 在第 2 欄；再看右邊取最大值，兩個都是 z = 3。反應跟著筆畫移動（等變），讀出不隨位置改變（不變）。〔功能：2〕
兩張 4×4 特徵圖，亮處從第 0 欄移到第 2 欄，最大值都是 3。
en: [Supplement] First see the two 4×4 feature maps on the left: F(x) is bright in column 0 (2, 3, 2, 1) and F(Tx) in column 2; then see the maximum on the right, z = 3 for both. The response moves with the stroke (equivariance) and the read-out does not change with position (invariance). [Function: 2]
Two 4×4 feature maps whose bright part moves from column 0 to column 2, both with maximum 3.

zh: ［補充］先看左邊：每個位置各有 10 個參數，16 × 10 = 160；再看右邊：全部共用同一組，9 + 1 = 10。十六個位置仍然都要算一次。〔功能：1、3〕
不共享 160 個參數、共享 10 個。
en: [Supplement] First see the left: every position has its own 10 parameters, 16 × 10 = 160; then the right: all positions share one set, 9 + 1 = 10. All sixteen positions are still computed. [Function: 1, 3]
160 parameters without sharing and 10 with sharing.

zh: ［補充］先看上方公式：共享梯度是各位置 δ 乘 x 的總和；再看兩個位置的乘積 0.6 與 −0.1，總梯度 0.5；右邊更新 k = 1 − 0.1 × 0.5 = 0.95。〔功能：2、3〕
en: [Supplement] First see the formula on top: the shared gradient is the sum of δ times x over positions; then the two products 0.6 and −0.1 with total gradient 0.5; the right updates k = 1 − 0.1 × 0.5 = 0.95. [Function: 2, 3]
Shared gradient 0.2×3 + (−0.1)×1 = 0.5 and the update k = 0.95.

zh: ［補充］先看三欄的標題（選不變特徵、架構約束、資料擴增）；再比較每一欄的做法與風險。〔功能：1、2〕
三條不變性路線的做法與風險。
en: [Supplement] First see the three column titles (invariant features, architectural constraints, data augmentation); then compare the method and the risk in each column. [Function: 1, 2]
The method and risk of the three routes to invariance.

zh: ［補充］先看左邊：兩條藍線位移都是 (1,1)，可共享；橘線位移 (2,2)，斜率相同卻不能共用；再看右邊的圓：(1,0) 與 (0,1) 長度都是 1。〔功能：2〕
位移相同的像素對可共享、長度相同的像素對可共享。
en: [Supplement] First see the left: both blue lines have displacement (1,1) and can share; the orange line has displacement (2,2), same slope but no sharing; then see the circle on the right: (1,0) and (0,1) both have length 1. [Function: 2]
Pixel pairs with equal displacement can share, and so can pairs of equal length.

zh: ［補充］先看上方的模型 v = b + Σaᵢxᵢ + cΣxᵢ²；再看 (1,0) 與 (0,1) 的平方和都是 1，但 a = (1,0) 時分數是 b + 1 + c 與 b + c，不相等：一個項對稱，不代表整體對稱。〔功能：2〕
平方項特例：平方和相同，但線性項讓兩點分數不同。
en: [Supplement] First see the model on top, v = b + Σaᵢxᵢ + cΣxᵢ²; then see that (1,0) and (0,1) both have sum of squares 1, but with a = (1,0) the scores b + 1 + c and b + c differ: one symmetric term does not make the model symmetric. [Function: 2]
The square-term case: equal sums of squares, but the linear term gives the two points different scores.

zh: ［補充］左邊是題 1：8×8 輸入得 6×6 特徵圖，不共享 360、共享 10 個參數；右邊是題 2：F(Tx) = TF(x)，是等變。〔功能：2〕
練習的解答：36 個位置、360 個參數、10 個參數；高分位置跟著移動是等變。
en: [Supplement] The left is Q1: an 8×8 input gives a 6×6 feature map, 360 parameters without sharing and 10 with it; the right is Q2: F(Tx) = TF(x), equivariance. [Function: 2]
Solutions: 36 positions, 360 parameters, 10 parameters; a high-score position that moves with the input is equivariance.

zh: ［補充］先看左邊的視窗精確式 r_ij 與共享梯度的鏈鎖法則；再看右邊有限網格的三種邊界情形：物件移出畫面、補值或步長不相容、影像旋轉需要插值。〔功能：2〕
共享視窗的精確式與有限網格的邊界情形。
en: [Supplement] First see the exact window formula r_ij and the chain rule of the shared gradient on the left; then the three boundary cases of a finite grid on the right: the object leaving the frame, incompatible padding or stride, and rotation needing interpolation. [Function: 2]
The exact shared-window formula and the boundary cases of a finite grid.
